combinations.readout: S273 phosphorylation of PPARγ in kidney
combinations.evidence_quote: When two compounds are combined, the inhibition of S273 phosphorylation was enhanced.

In inflammatory pain model, the drug combination of GSK 2256294 (an sEH inhibitor, IC50=27 pM) and Pioglitazone (a PPARγ agonist, EC50= 0.93 μM) was administrated to determine with better effects than the alone administration.

combinations.magnitude: effect of SP-C01 cancelled by GW9662
combinations.evidence_quote: Further experiments showed that the PPARγ antagonist GW9662 can cancel the effect of SP-C01 at 10 μM on p-PPARγ in all the three types of cells.

combinations.magnitude: effect of SP-C01 reversed by GW9662
combinations.evidence_quote: When combined RSG and SP-C01 with GW9662, it can reverse the effect of medication alone on GLUT4 expression in the three cell types (Figure 8A-F).
